chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakuni, from Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad, from his father عليه السلام:
Indeed, ʿAli عليه السلام crucified a man in al-Hirah for three days, then took him down on the fourth day, prayed over him, and buried him.

key_terms.السَّكُونِيِّ: al-Sakuni, the narrator cited in the chain
key_terms.بِالْحِيرَةِ: in al-Hirah, the location where the event occurred
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ: for three days, the stated duration
key_terms.فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ: he performed funeral prayer over him

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of Imam ʿAli عليه السلام say about crucifixion duration and burial afterward?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam ʿAli عليه السلام crucified a man in al-Hirah for three days, then had him taken down on the fourth day. It also indicates that after the punishment, the deceased was given funeral rites and burial.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5123 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), it is reported:
"Indeed, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) crucified a man in Al-Hirah for three days. Then on the fourth day, Imam (as) took him down, prayed over him, and buried him."
